series_end_reason: Last own line is the 10-K for 2023 (full year); the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2024 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/875320/000087532024000139/vrtx-20240331.htm) prints only TRIKAFTA/KAFTRIO and an 'Other CF products' row (207.0 for Q1 2024, 278.1 for Q1 2023 = KALYDECO 125.0 + ORKAMBI 122.5 + SYMDEKO/SYMKEVI 30.6 as printed in the Q1 2023 10-Q), and the earnings releases print only TRIKAFTA/KAFTRIO by name from the first quarter of 2023.
search_log: Listed every filing for Vertex Pharmaceuticals (CIK 0000875320) from data.sec.gov/submissions (recent block plus older 'files' pages), no form filter at listing time; selected forms starting '8-K' (8-K and 8-K/A) carrying Item 2.02 filed 2010-01-01 or later (75 filings) and fetched every non-primary .htm exhibit from each filing's index.json; fetched every 10-Q, 10-K, 10-Q/A and 10-K/A primary document filed 2011-01-01 or later.

Q1-Q3 rows are the current three-month column of the product row in each 10-Q's 'product revenues, net' by-product table (located as a row starting with the brand that is followed within ten rows by a 'Total product revenues' row). Q4 rows: the fourth-quarter release (the Item 2.02 8-K filed January-March whose exhibit prints a 'Twelve Months Ended December 31' column, which excludes the January preliminary releases) is used when one of its brand rows prints a figure within 1.0 of the 10-K full year less the three 10-Q quarters; otherwise the row is derived from the 10-K (annual_less_reported_first_nine_months).

Fourth-quarter 2019 is derived from the 10-K for every CF product, because the fourth-quarter 2019 release prints its by-product table under 'Non-GAAP Product revenues, net' (it excludes a $155.8 million ORKAMBI France early-access adjustment); the 10-K figures are GAAP.

2019Q4 (GAAP, derived from the 10-K) includes the $155.8 million France early-access adjustment recognized in that quarter for prior-period shipments; the fourth-quarter 2019 release's Non-GAAP by-product table prints ORKAMBI 270 excluding it.

Four quarters vs the 10-K full-year line (USD millions): 2016 979.7 vs 10-K 979.6; 2017 1320.5 vs 10-K 1320.8; 2018 1262.2 vs 10-K 1262.2; 2019 1331.9 vs 10-K 1331.9; 2020 907.0 vs 10-K 907.5; 2021 771.2 vs 10-K 771.6; 2022 510.9 vs 10-K 510.7; 2023 326.0 vs 10-K 326.0 (differences are within the rounding of the release figures).
